parameters.name: ComputeCategory
parameters.description:
The computing power category. Valid values:

- economy: economy

- general: general-purpose

parameters.name: ContainerGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the instances. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the instance, which is also the name of the container group.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description:
The number of resources to return. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 20.

> The number of returned resources may be less than but will not be greater than the specified value.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that marks the start of the next query. If this parameter is empty, no more results are returned.

> You do not need to set this parameter for the first query. The token for a subsequent query is obtained from the response to the previous query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

- Pending: The instance is starting.

- Running: The instance is running.

- Succeeded: The instance ran successfully.

- Failed: The instance failed to run.

- Scheduling: The instance is being created.

- ScheduleFailed: The instance failed to be created.

- Restarting: The instance is being restarted.

- Updating: The instance is being updated.

- Terminating: The instance is being stopped.

- Expired: The instance has expired.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the instance.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the instance.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual switch to which the instance is connected.

parameters.name: WithEvent
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return event information.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone where the instance is located. If you leave this parameter empty, the system selects a zone.

The default value is empty.
